title: The Changing Office
text:
Remote work has become much more common in the last few years. Many companies now allow employees to work from home for part of the week. This change has made it easier for people to balance their jobs with family responsibilities. However, some managers worry that teams find it harder to communicate when they rarely meet in person.

Experts predict that hybrid working will continue to grow. Workers who want flexibility often choose jobs that offer it, which means employers must think carefully about their policies. Some companies are also opening small offices in smaller towns, so that people do not have to live close to big cities. As a result, the future of work may depend less on location than it did in the past.

questions.text: According to the first paragraph, what has made it easier for people to balance their jobs with family responsibilities?
options: Working from home for part of the week

questions.text: According to the second paragraph, what are some companies also doing?
options: Opening small offices in smaller towns
Hiring only people who live in big cities

questions.text: What can be inferred about employers who want to attract flexible workers?
options: They can ignore their policies because flexibility is unimportant.
They need to consider their policies carefully.
They should require everyone to live in big cities.
They will never need to change how they work.

questions.text: Why might some managers be worried about remote work?
options: Remote workers never complete their tasks.
Teams may find it harder to communicate when they rarely meet.
Offices in small towns are too expensive to rent.
Employees always refuse to work from home.

vocabulary.definition: done from a place away from the main office, often at home
the ability to change or adapt to different needs or times
to share information or ideas with other people
official rules or plans that an organisation follows

paragraph_translations: Praca zdalna stała się w ostatnich latach znacznie bardziej powszechna. Wiele firm pozwala teraz pracownikom pracować z domu przez część tygodnia. Ta zmiana ułatwiła ludziom pogodzenie pracy z obowiązkami rodzinnymi. Niektórzy menedżerowie obawiają się jednak, że zespołom trudniej się komunikować, gdy rzadko spotykają się osobiście.

Eksperci przewidują, że praca hybrydowa będzie nadal zyskiwać na popularności. Pracownicy, którzy chcą elastyczności, często wybierają prace, które ją oferują, co oznacza, że pracodawcy muszą dokładnie przemyśleć swoje zasady. Niektóre firmy otwierają też małe biura w mniejszych miastach, dzięki czemu ludzie nie muszą mieszkać blisko dużych aglomeracji. W rezultacie przyszłość pracy może zależeć bardziej od miejsca niż dawniej.
